about: Which purpose each screen serves, decided before any screen is built (R90) and scored on R91's axes against the seven walked reference apps. The Inventory screens, under purpose set S5, approved by the owner on 2026-11-25; the Wardrobe, Pantry and Shopping screens are provisional until each module is designed (R97, stage 10), and the homepage is designed last (R84).

P1.name: Log
P1.job: get things into the app, by hand or from a photo, and fix what was logged

P2.name: Find
P2.job: find a thing and see where it is

P3.name: Arrange
P3.job: keep places and tags in order and things where they belong

P4.name: Use up and buy
P4.job: keep track of what runs out, wears or needs buying, and buy it

P5.name: Look after the app
P5.job: keep the data safe and the app set up

screens.name: Homepage
screens.holds: open places from the homepage; see an object of the day; choose the homepage cards

screens.name: Search and results
screens.holds: search items by name or tag; filter search by house or floor; see items not yet placed; move several items at once; add or remove tags in bulk; bulk edit fields on several items; see things expiring soon

screens.name: Expiration timeline
screens.holds: see every expiry date, closest first

screens.name: Item page
screens.holds: edit an item's name, notes and fields; record an item's quantity; split identical things into separate items; mark an item away and back; move an item to another place; tag items and places; add a brand, model or purchase date; set expiry and opening dates; record last worn and laundry state; restore an overwritten value from history

screens.name: Quick add
screens.holds: add an item by name only; dictate a list of things to log

screens.name: Capture and proposals
screens.holds: log an item photo first, name later; take photos of items and places; log things from a photo as proposals; correct proposed lines in a few taps; split a photo into items with counts; accept or delete suggested tags; clear all suggested tags at once; get tag and place suggestions; group logged things by similarity; read expiry dates from label photos; recognise phone photos on the pc

screens.name: Fields
screens.holds: define custom fields; attach a field to tags or items; rename, hide or edit module preset fields

screens.name: Place page
screens.holds: build a place tree across several sites; give a place tags, notes, photo; see what is inside a place; see a place's path up the tree; move a place with its contents; mark items on a settled-area photo; print photo labels with a qr code; open a place from its label qr; open a place from an nfc tag

screens.name: Place map
screens.holds: browse a visual map of places; rearrange place blocks on the map; draw the place map freely

screens.name: Tags
screens.holds: nest tags under a parent tag; give a kept-together tag a home place; see a tag's items away from home; set a tag's kind and edit kinds; browse top-level tags

screens.name: Photos
screens.holds: see which photos are outdated; browse places by their photos

screens.name: Backup and restore
screens.holds: export and import data with photos; restore a backup by merging; roll back to a backup

screens.name: Running out and wear
screens.status: provisional: confirmed when its module is designed (R97, stage 10)
screens.holds: see an item's usage rate; count stock with − and +; set a minimum stock; see an estimated run-out day; put together outfits; swap clothes at the change of season; see clothes not worn in a year

screens.name: Lists and store lists
screens.status: provisional: confirmed when its module is designed (R97, stage 10)
screens.holds: send finished consumables to the shopping list; keep a shopping list; keep a wish list; add low-stock items to the list; see what is already owned and where; edit shopping lists on the pc; make a store list; pin a store list for repeated runs; tick items bought with price paid; tick products sold by weight; add a bag when ticking; mark a discount when ticking; untick before the receipt closes; close a receipt at the till; discount a whole receipt; get warned about other store lists; send receipts to the savings app

screens.name: Prices
screens.status: provisional: confirmed when its module is designed (R97, stage 10)
screens.holds: compare packs by price per unit; compare one product across stores; keep shop prices and promotions; add, rename and delete stores; mark products a store carries

screens.name: Settings
screens.holds: download larger optional models; use an ai-service key for recognition; choose approximate or exact counts; turn modules on or off; give items and wishes a savings category; turn on the savings export; sync phone and pc through a folder; back up automatically to a chosen folder; switch the app's language; get expiry notifications; get low-stock notifications; get add-to-list notifications; get usage-rate notifications; get run-out notifications for chosen items; get laundry notifications; get a seasonal swap notification

screens.name: Widget, lock screen and prompts
screens.holds: keep a place or tag in view; show stored things on the lock screen; get an opt-in rediscover prompt

where.thing: a place and what it holds

repeats: stock counted with − and + in the running-out view
laundry marked from the clothes in the running-out view

owner_answers: 2026-11-25: scoring defaults for R91 accepted; screen count as functions per screen and steps against the fewest taps, after the first scoring let five reference apps win.
2026-11-25: screens by purpose confirmed for the Inventory module only; the other modules are not yet conceptually developed.
2026-11-25: an expiration timeline lists every item with an expiry date, closest first (R153); expiring soon is a filter on Search and results.
2026-11-25: the homepage is designed last, after every module is complete (R84).
